cohort: 52 pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 who delivered between March 15th and July 4th in seven university affiliated hospitals in Israel
finding: Vaginal delivery rates were high among SARS-CoV-2-infected mothers and were associated with favorable outcomes, including no cases of neonatal COVID-19.
mod_finding: Among the 43 women who underwent a trial of labor, 39 (90.7%) delivered vaginally, whereas 4 (9.3%) cases resulted in cesarean delivery.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 38 weeks
